The Service Provider shall send vehicle to duty (preferably in white colour) o n fully filled tank condition along with all other required compliance. 11. Driver shall be provided with white uniform with cap by the contractor, cost of which will be borne by the contractor. 13. A working mobile phone should always be available with the driver. Cost of t he mobile phone use will b e borne by the contractor. 14. In case driver is advised to attend any other person than the regular user, h e should contact the person and inform about his where about and receive the m. 15. Driver should help the user in arranging the luggage in the vehicle. He shoul d open the doors and ensure that the occupants are safely seated before closin g the door. 16. Immediately after the contract is awarded, contractor shall visit the user wit h all the documents for verification. This shall be done within 3 days from the d ate of award of contract. 17. Any deficiency in the above services will attract a penalty as per GeM contr act. 18. A red board with "On duty, Government of India" to be put in the front of the vehicle. 19. The interior and exterior should be kept clean and hygienic and a clean tow el over the seat to be provided by the contactor. Every day, interior should be s prayed with air freshener. 20. Vehicle is required to move throughout the jurisdiction of Eastern Railway o r beyond. All the license, permit etc. required for the purpose shall be always av ailable. In case of visit to outstation, no extra payment to the contractor/driver will be made. 21. Daily Duty also includes Saturdays, Sundays & holidays deemed fit by the C ompetent Authority as when required at any moment of the Day etc. 22. 2500 km/month is only indicative. The vehicle may run more than 2500 km in a month if required. 23. The unutilized Km run during the month will carry forward to next month. 24. Top model of SUV vehicle ( Mohindra Bolero Neo) with commercial re gistration of 2026 will be preferred. 25. No accommodation & Garage facilities will be provided by the Railway to th e Driver & for the Vehicle. C ontractor has to make his own arrangements for th ese facilities. 26. Driver of the vehicle shall maintain a Log Book indicating details of daily ru nning of vehicles. 27. The competent authority, Eastern Railway also reserves the right to termina te the contract at any time during the period of the contract serving a prior noti ce for 15 days without assigning any reason.

28. In case of unavailability of incumbent for the allotted vehicle, an allotted ve hicle may be withdrawn till the further availability of incumbent within variation condition of GeM contract. 29. No extra charges will be paid for night working if any. 30. No mileage will be paid by Railway for drivers’ lunch/breakfast or for drawl o f fuel etc. .
